in_hebrew.name: Fast
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fast הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'ταχύς' (tachys), meaning 'swift' or 'quick'. In Christian tradition, Fast represents the virtue of self-discipline, particularly through religious fasting.
